sources.license_usage_notes: Official public map service; preserve agency attribution. Repository report does not establish a reuse license, so publication/redistribution must be reviewed.
sources.review_notes: Static model feature only; never a flood outcome label.

sources.coverage: 187 Caloocan barangays unaffected by the Barangay 176 split; 176-A through 176-F excluded pending geometry
sources.license_usage_notes: Retains repository source/provenance limitations; structural validation is not an independent legal boundary survey.
sources.review_notes: Authoritative geometry for 176-A through 176-F is not present; legacy 176 must not be used as current geometry.

sources.coverage: Caloocan municipality filter available; detailed access not configured in the repository environment
sources.license_usage_notes: Detailed API requires approved token access. Token and responses must remain server-side; historical forecast availability and reuse terms require confirmation.
sources.review_notes: Not approved for training until rainfall units, accumulation semantics, historical at-issuance availability, and usage terms are verified.

sources.source_name: PAGASA observed climatological data request route
sources.coverage: Requested station or approved gridded coverage; Caloocan/NCR suitability not yet confirmed
sources.license_usage_notes: Requires PAGASA request approval and compliance with supplied terms and attribution requirements.
sources.review_notes: No local historical rainfall file was acquired in Phase 7B.

sources.source_name: PAGASA CliMap v2 historical climate data
sources.coverage: Philippines gridded climate platform with NCR/municipality selection; exact Caloocan grid extraction not acquired
sources.license_usage_notes: Download requires registration and agreement to PAGASA terms/privacy conditions. Exact file metadata and permitted reuse must be retained with any acquired file.
sources.review_notes: Potential source for observed/antecedent rainfall only. Exact temporal coverage, grid resolution, unit, accumulation definition, and training suitability must be verified from the acquired file metadata.

sources.source_name: Flooding Incident in Caloocan City, 24 June 2019
sources.coverage: Caloocan City; exact spatial and temporal observations require document review
sources.license_usage_notes: Official public incident page. Review the linked documents and applicable reuse terms before extracting evidence.
sources.review_notes: Candidate evidence only; not a verified label and provides no negative observations.

sources.source_name: Situation Report No. 18 for Southwest Monsoon enhanced by TCs Egay and Falcon
sources.coverage: National situation report containing Caloocan location wording; exact spatial interpretation requires review
sources.license_usage_notes: Official public situation report; retain report/version attribution and verify any extracted entry against the document.
sources.review_notes: Candidate evidence only; report wording is not automatically a barangay label or a negative observation.
